body: What Do I call Holy? - HOLY BANCOOKIE!
What do I think of holy?

Holy is hardworking, honest, strong, always spending alot of energy and time supporting others genuinely, he is just one of the most kindhearted and warm people you will ever meet. To me Holy was the first one who ever believed in me and will always have a special place in my heart! When there was no one, there was Holy, and he pushed me to become stronger, and do my best. In my lowest days he cheered me on, and on the brightest ones, he cheered alongside me! I can only wish he can feel the same way about himself~
